output.reason: [ev-22d171f57c1e] says the change is a bug fix in the Loki Ruler. Before the fix, concurrent read-write access to tenant configs could cause a panic when there were many rules; the fix removes that panic. That is enough to write the applicability: environments that run the Ruler component on versions before 3.0.0, with exposure growing as the rule count rises. The excerpt does not give a threshold for "a large amount of rules", so the applicability can name the Ruler as the exposed component but cannot set a numeric cutoff.
